_doc: Architectural / interior-design vocabulary used to compose photoreal prompts. Hand-curated. Pick from these in your spec, or write your own — anything goes; this is a starting palette.

styles.japandi: japandi, scandinavian-japanese fusion, warm minimalism, soft palette
styles.scandi: scandinavian minimalism, light woods, calm white palette, hygge
styles.wabi_sabi: wabi-sabi, imperfect beauty, raw materials, earthy patina
styles.biophilic: biophilic design, abundant plants, natural light, organic textures, living wall
styles.mid_century_modern: mid-century modern, walnut wood, brass accents, atomic-era curves
styles.contemporary_minimal: contemporary minimalism, clean lines, monochromatic palette, ample negative space
styles.brutalist: brutalist, raw concrete, exposed structure, monolithic forms
styles.industrial_loft: industrial loft, exposed brick, black steel beams, oversized factory windows
styles.art_deco: art deco, geometric patterns, brass and marble, velvet textures, sunburst motifs
styles.mediterranean: mediterranean, plaster walls, terracotta tile, olive wood, arched openings
styles.boho: bohemian, layered rugs, rattan, jute, eclectic textiles, plants
styles.luxe_modern: luxury modern, book-matched marble, brushed brass, mohair velvet, large-format porcelain

floors: european white-oak engineered planks, matte oil finish
walls: white limewash with subtle cloud variation
dark stained walnut veneer, vertical grain
raw cast-in-place concrete, matrix board imprint
ribbed plaster panel, soft shadow grooves

fixtures: Isamu Noguchi Akari paper lantern pendant
Flos IC suspension, opal glass globe
Roll & Hill Modo, brass arms with milk-glass orbs
recessed plaster-in trim downlights, miniature aperture
linear cove LED 2700K, hidden in plaster reveal
alabaster wall sconces flanking a fireplace
table lamp with pleated linen shade, ceramic base
qualities: soft natural daylight, golden hour, long shadows
warm 2700K interior lighting, layered ambient + task + accent
dramatic chiaroscuro with single accent spot
blue-hour twilight with interior lights glowing

seating: Camaleonda modular sofa by Mario Bellini, bouclé ivory
USM Haller storage in matte white
Hans Wegner CH25 lounge chair, oak and paper cord
Carl Hansen wishbone chair (CH24), soaped oak
Pierre Jeanneret office chair, teak and cane
low-slung Japanese floor sofa with linen slipcover
tables: Isamu Noguchi coffee table, walnut and glass
Saarinen Tulip dining table, marble top
Mater Bowl side table, matte black
storage: USM Haller modular sideboard, matte white
fluted oak built-in millwork with brass pulls
kitchen: handle-less matte lacquer cabinetry, sage green
monolithic stone island with waterfall edge
bathroom: frameless walk-in shower with rain head

neutrals: putty, mushroom, oat milk, bone, parchment

atmospheres.lived_in: softly worn, books and personal objects, lived in

camera_views.wide_corner: wide-angle 24mm corner shot, eye-level (~1.6 m), straight verticals (architectural correction)
camera_views.intimate_35mm: 35mm prime, eye-level, shallow depth of field on hero object, room receding softly
camera_views.low_hero: low 28mm hero shot looking up slightly, dramatic ceiling lines
camera_views.axial_one_point: one-point perspective from doorway, perfect axial composition
camera_views.human_85mm: 85mm portrait-style intimate vignette of a furniture group

tech_quality: global illumination, soft contact shadows, no flare
